FULL TEXT:
UNIVERSITY INSTITUTE OF PHARMACEUTICAL SCIENCES
PANJAB UNIVERSITY, CHANDIGARH
ADVERTISEMENT FOR THE POST OF JUNIOR RESEARCH FELLOW
Applications are invited from suitable candidates for the post of Junior Research Fellow under the
DST-SERB SURE research grant for the project entitled “Mechanistic Role of Pyruvate
Dehydrogenase Kinase-4 in Smooth Muscle Cell proliferation and Intimal Hyperplasia in The
Comorbid Condition of Diabetes” under the supervision of Dr. Manish Jain (Principal Investigator),
Prof. Kanwaljit Chopra and Dr. Anurag Kuhad (Co- Principal Investigator), University Institute of
Pharmaceutical Sciences, Panjab University, Chandigarh. Selected candidate will have the option to
register for PhD program subject to institutional guidelines.
Essential Qualification:
1. B. Pharm and M. Pharm. (preferably in Pharmacology) with minimum 55% marks (50% in case
of SC/ST/PH).
2. GATE/GPAT, CSIR-NET or any National entrance test exam conducted by any central Govt.
department
Desirable qualification and experience:
The candidate should have experience in Molecular Biology techniques. Having experience in
working with animal models and mammalian cell culture techniques will be preferred.
Age: Not more than 35 years as on closing date of advertisement.
Fellowship:
Monthly emoluments of fellowship shall be as per DST norms. The initial offer will be for the period of
one year and can be extended subject to satisfactory performance. The position is temporary and
coterminous with the project.
Selection process:
Eligible and shortlisted candidates will be called for interview in the office of Chairperson, UIPS,
Panjab University, Chandigarh or may be interviewed through teleconference.
Applications along with Curriculum Vitae may be submitted to the office of the undersigned by email
or sent by post latest by 20th November, 2023. The date and time of the interview will be informed to
the shortlisted candidates by email. No separate interview letters will be issued.
NOTE: No TA/DA shall be paid for attending the interview.
Dr. Manish Jain
Ramalingaswami Fellow
University Institute of Pharmaceutical Sciences
Panjab University, Chandigarh-160014
E-mail: manishjain.cdri@gmail.com
